# MoreHuman Ed

> A personal, independent space for tips, ideas and reflections on keeping people at the centre of learning, by Diego Guevara, a science educator. Bilingual (English and Spanish). Nothing is for sale and no services are offered. The site uses no cookies or tracking.

## Pages
- [Home](https://morehumaned.com/): what I'm exploring, videos and notes
- [Videos](https://morehumaned.com/en/tutorials.html): short videos with tips
- [About](https://morehumaned.com/en/about.html): about Diego Guevara
- [About this site](https://morehumaned.com/en/privacy.html): independence, how AI is used, privacy
- [Inicio (Spanish)](https://morehumaned.com/es/index.html): the site in Spanish
